draft_en.subject: The SW802G / SW811G-DIN positions - built to your spec from small lots, component list included
draft_en.body:
Hi Zehua,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 8 October 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the SW-series PoE switches under your label, two positions built to your spec from small lots, CE/RoHS: SW802G - 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); SW811G-DIN - DIN-rail industrial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C - STI-288GP - $62.2. On NDAA: we make no claim either way - the component list goes with the sample and your guide decides.

One question: which model is due for a second source first - the desktop 8-port or the DIN unit?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
